acceptance: Capture the real React/CSS at 320×568, 390×844, 768×1024, 1023×900, 1440×900 and 1920×1080. Capture every step, both program kinds, both Wallet concepts, draft exit, launch success and launch failure.

Count visible words in each default phone first viewport, including the fixed action area. Each must stay below 40. Do not count punctuation-only separators as words. The Card composition is designed for 39 words, not claimed measured.

No authored explanatory block contains 18 or more words. Keep material rules readable. Report validation, expanded documents and user-entered terms separately; never conceal them or shrink type to meet the baseline count.
This route contains no public-site sequence. Do not import that sequence or claim its separate under-30-word target has been checked here.
Program exposes exactly Visits and Points. Changing kind preserves the reward name and maintains separate remembered requirements, initially 5 and 100.
Direct entry to a later step returns to the earliest incomplete prerequisite. A live program blocks creation until an explicit Design Lab scenario replacement.
Card controls change the actual coded preview. Reward title and reward name are the same draft field. Platform selection never changes the program kind.
Inspect the Loopday asset before accepting its crop. Record source dimensions and crop positions in the V3 media manifest. Missing media never silently becomes another cafe's photograph.
Scan exported QR artwork with an ordinary reader. Draft QR payloads are explicitly non-enrollment specimen text; launched QR payloads use the current origin and V3 signup route.
A launch creates one local simulated program with zero members. It produces no SIGNUP, WALLET_ADDED, issued pass, notification or production request.
Draft signup inspection and Wallet-choice inspection create no working members, counter events or saved-Wallet projections.
Verify copy success only after clipboard success. Downloads must contain the actual QR and visible demo label. Browser printing occurs only after Print demo.
Test Back, Close, browser Back, reload, failed draft save, failed launch, invalid inputs, missing artwork and clipboard rejection without losing uncommitted form values.
Test keyboard-only operation, focus restoration, 200% text zoom, reduced motion and safe-area clearance. No essential action may depend on dragging, hover or animation.
Approve only after browser captures and event assertions reconcile. This specification is approval to build the isolated surface, not approval of an unseen implementation.
spec.signature_moment: The return becomes an object before it becomes administration: five quiet strokes establish the rule, the same rule inhabits a recognizable Wallet card, and that card hands off to one counter QR. TapMart-specific continuity replaces a generic form wizard. Nothing deliberately defective is added to satisfy the schema's wording.

honest_states: Initial creation is the No program replacement context. Brand defaults are available, but no live card, usable acquisition link or member exists.
A Draft scenario resumes a visits draft with reward and requirement completed; Card is the first incomplete step. Last completed step is stored locally, not inferred from the URL.
Direct entry while the seeded program is live shows only the live-program guard and View program. The lab selector is the explicit route to blank creation.
Pre-launch QR codes encode draft specimen text, not an enrollment URL. Their label states that activation follows launch.
Card states are examples. Default Sara at 3 of 5 references the September 13 specimen, not her September 17 working balance of 4 of 5.
Signup inspection is non-enrolling. Its form commit remains disabled. Wallet-choice inspection uses a separate zero-progress specimen, not a newly created working member.
Successful launch is Live · simulated with zero members. The source registry becomes usable only inside the local working scenario.
Draft saving persists across V3 route changes, not reload. Failures preserve values and do not advance completion status.
A missing photograph becomes a labelled plain fallback. A removed photograph becomes an intentional solid-colour card without an error label.
Updated offer inspects pass details, preserves the chosen reward state and sends nothing.
No business navigation, fake browser chrome, native Wallet sheet, pass-issued state, delivery claim, contact marketing channel or creator member access appears.
spec.two_second_read: Choose the rule. See the actual card. Put its signup QR on the counter, entirely simulated here.
media: Brand artwork: /design-lab/reference-loopday-01.jpg only. Read intrinsic dimensions and reserve them. Step 1 phone uses a 358×104 horizontal composition: solid ink on the left, a 132×104 contained photograph on the right. Desktop uses a 476×317 stage with the source contained against ink. No colour grade, gradient, generated replacement or inferred identity. Containment is the safe initial treatment until the manifest crop is inspected.

Coded Loopday loop mark: 48×48 reference box, circle centre 24,24, radius 16, 3px stroke, no fill, butt ends. Leave the clockwise sector from 0° to 45° open, with 0° at the right. Extend the right endpoint vertically downward by 6px in brick #B73E28. The remaining arc is ink on paper and paper on ink. Use 32×32 in card headers and 40×40 in the brand object. It is artwork, never a completion badge.

Coded rule marks: five 2px horizontal strokes with 8px gaps, sharing a straight datum. In Step 1 they are equal outlined/ink marks with no earned-state semantics. In Step 2 the complete requirement is represented by the adjacent rule string, not by a fictitious member balance. Do not render 100 points as 100 tiny marks.

Apple concept: coded store-card representation at a 375×520 reference size; 12px boundary radius, no outer SaaS container or shadow. Reference vertical allocation: 64px logo header, 123px strip, 88px combined fields, 24px space, 164px QR, 8px gap, 18px readable ID, 31px bottom space. Height grows for wrapping. Do not scale the text with the card width.

Apple strip: 375:123. Left 225px is solid card colour with the one primary label/value. Right 150px contains the Loopday photograph using its separately stored Apple crop. No text crosses photography. At narrow widths the primary zone remains at least 60% of the strip. With removed artwork the entire strip is solid colour.

Apple fields: system font; logo text 16px/20 semibold, primary label 11px/16 medium, primary value 32px/36 semibold, secondary labels 11px/16 and values 16px/20. Primary is VISITS or POINTS. The three combined secondary/auxiliary fields are REWARD, MEMBER and STATUS. Their values may wrap. No additional front field, progress widget or front action is added.

Google concept: coded loyalty representation, 375px reference width and approximately 550 to 580px content-led height, 12px boundary radius. Top identity uses a 36px circular logo crop, Loopday Rewards at 20px/24 and Loopday Coffee at 13px/18. Follow with a full-width 3:1 hero, then a two-column Visits or Points / Rewards balance row, Member and Member ID fields, and the QR. Use system typography. Requirement, status, terms and offer are Details content, not an invented Apple-style auxiliary row.

Google colour treatment: apply the selected background hex. Approximate platform-controlled readable text in the concept; do not promise independent label or value colour controls. The Apple text and label settings remain stored when switching platforms.

Specimen member QR: valid QR, version 4, error correction M, 33×33 encoded modules plus a four-module quiet zone on every edge; render the full 41×41 grid at 164×164 CSS pixels. Black modules on white, no logo, rounding, animated modules or caption inside the quiet zone. Sara payload is tapmart-v3:specimen:loopday:sara; Tess payload is tapmart-v3:specimen:loopday:tess. Counter recording must reject both specimen payloads.

Draft acquisition QR: valid coded QR encoding tapmart-v3:draft:loopday. It is explicitly not an enrollment link. Render black on white with four-module quiet zones, error correction M, square modules and integer module sizing. Target complete symbol size 246px at 390, at least 205px at 320, and 328px on desktop; select the nearest whole-module size that fits.

Launched acquisition QR: regenerate only after local launch. Payload is the current origin followed by /design-lab-v3/join/loopday-counter. Choose the smallest sufficient QR version at error correction M, preserve four-module quiet zones and use integer module sizing. Never reuse either specimen-member payload. Show the exact relative path as selectable text outside the code.

Downloaded QR concept: self-contained SVG artwork, 1080×1350, paper background, Loopday mark, business name, reward, current numeric rule, QR, Scan to join and Demo QR · Design Lab only. QR complete-symbol target is 574px, rounded down to an integer module multiple. Filename is loopday-demo-qr.svg. It contains no external image dependency and no Wallet badge.

Print concept: A5 portrait, 148×210mm, white background, 16mm page margins. Brand and reward occupy the top 42mm; the rule follows. Centre a complete QR at least 61.5mm square with its quiet zone. Scan to join and Demo QR · Design Lab only sit below. Hide inspection controls from print. Do not create a print-order service.

No other supplied photo, creator portrait, Story creative, screenshot, illustration or operating-system badge is needed on this surface. Wallet actions are exact text buttons because no official badge asset is included.
states: 0, Route guard. Resolve the local scenario before drawing a specimen. Existing live program: show Loopday already has a live program. and View program. No program: begin Program. Draft: resume the first incomplete step. Invalid later-step links return to the earliest incomplete prerequisite with Complete this step first.

1, Program. Visits is selected initially. Two operable unboxed choices show the award sentence. The daily rule remains visible. Continue records the selection as locally complete; it does not create a program record.

2, Reward. Show the complete rule above editable reward name and numeric requirement. Terms starts collapsed and empty. Visits accepts integers 2 to 50; points accepts 2 to 10,000 with a fixed award of one. Invalid Continue focuses the first error without clearing values.

3, Card. Apple is initially selected. Show the branded coded specimen before controls on phone and beside them on desktop. Changing a valid field updates the preview; invalid colour syntax retains the last valid preview and exposes the field error.

3a, Card controls. Local logo and image selection, platform-specific crop, business name, Google program name, supported colours and the shared reward title are editable. Use brand defaults is reversible through Undo and never changes kind, requirement, reward name or terms.

3b, Card inspection. Collecting is the default. Reward ready changes specimen progress to the requirement and ready quantity to one. Reward redeemed shows zero progress and zero ready quantity. Updated offer preserves the preceding progress/status and opens Details to show the offer. No specimen selection emits working events.

3c, Card Details. An external wrapper reveals supported back/details fields. No flipping pass, native menu imitation or actionable pass front. Closing returns focus to Details or the selector that opened it.

4, Signup. The counter acquisition object leads. Counter QR is the initial source; Creator link selects the registered Jasmine example for inspection only. Phone uses Preview signup; desktop shows the readable customer inspection beside the QR.

4a, Customer inspection. Show the short customer form with Tess and fictional contact as read-only values. Email/phone switching changes the inspected field, not data collection. Agreement is unchecked and disabled. Create my card is disabled with Launch before joining. Legal links remain operable.

4b, Wallet-choice inspection. Preview Wallet choices opens a distinct Tess specimen at zero progress, with both simulated Wallet actions. Opening either shows the matching concept and simulated-add receipt. This does not add Tess or change any saved-Wallet projection.

5, Launch review. Show the current business, current numeric rule, Draft, the non-enrollment draft QR and the daily rule. Terms is available before commitment. Design-state examples do not become member counts or launch progress.

5a, Launch commit. Disable activation immediately. Commit one local program and activate the counter/source registry together. Success replaces the draft QR payload with the V3 signup URL and shows Live · simulated, 0 members and No pass is issued. No artificial loading delay is added.

5b, Launch result. QR is the leading object. Open loyalty is primary. Copy demo link, Download demo QR, Preview printout and Open signup are secondary. Opening signup stays in the same provider and can now reach the separate working signup surface.
5c, Launch failure. Keep Draft, the inactive QR and every input. Show Couldn’t launch the demo program. and Try again. Retry uses the same launch operation identity; no duplicate program is possible.

6, Draft save and exit. Save draft validates entered field syntax but does not require later steps. Close with meaningful changes opens Keep draft, Discard demo draft and Keep editing. Keep draft saves locally and returns to the originating Loyalty surface. Failed saving keeps the layer and draft intact.

7, Inspection tools. Platform menu, crop, documents, printout and Design Lab controls are reversible layers. Browser Back closes the top layer before changing a wizard step. Changing step preserves the draft and invalidates only downstream completion that depends on an edited value.
large_desktop: At 1920, cap the focused task at 1280px and centre it; outer margins are 320px. Do not reintroduce a business sidebar or add a preview dashboard.
Use twelve columns with 24px gaps. The card spread becomes approximately 519px for the specimen side and 737px for controls, but the Wallet itself stays at 375px reference width.
The Step 1 artwork stage may grow to 519×346. App titles remain 36px, not public-display size.
QR complete-symbol size remains approximately 328px. Add breathing room around the acquisition object rather than enlarging it into a poster-sized interface.
The full five-label step navigation remains a single plain row. No additional progress percentages, member counts or decorative previews appear.

Treat the QR as one graphic with an accessible description identifying specimen or acquisition purpose. Its data is available through Details or the separate signup link, not through an unreadable module-by-module announcement.
Crop supports keyboard sliders: horizontal and vertical position 0 to 100 in single-unit increments; zoom 1 to 3 in 0.05 increments. Dragging is optional.
Modal layers trap focus, support Escape and browser Back, mark the background inert and restore the opener. Closing a dirty task opens the explicit exit decision.
After step navigation focus the step title. After launch focus Live · simulated; announce the final status once. Clipboard success and errors use one polite live region.

Fixed action areas include safe-area padding and matching document clearance. At 200% zoom use ordinary document-flow actions if a fixed footer would obscure inputs or leave less than 240px of usable content.
File selection invokes the browser's native chooser only after Change logo or Change image. Browser-owned chooser and print-dialog wording is not fabricated in the React surface.

on_demand: Back moves to the preceding validated step without clearing input. At Program it returns to the originating Loyalty surface, using the dirty-exit decision when necessary.
Close opens the draft decision only after meaningful changes. Save draft at the end of a step gives an inline in-memory receipt; Keep draft saves and exits.
Terms in Reward opens the optional textarea. The daily rule is never hidden inside it. Full fixed customer terms remain available in signup inspection and final review.
The platform-concept label opens Apple Wallet / Google Wallet selection. On desktop these same choices are also plain text tabs in the editing column; they are not additional card-front fields.
Card controls on phone scrolls to the editing heading using a native anchor. No guided tour, mandatory next tooltip or artificial blank space is inserted to make the preview fit.
Change logo and Change image open a local chooser. Accepted images are decoded in memory. Failures leave the last valid image intact. No upload receipt or production Brand Kit change is shown.

Crop opens the actual active-platform image window: Apple's photographic portion is 150:123; Google's hero is 3:1. Position and zoom are stored separately per platform. Initial placement contains the full source when a safe crop has not been verified.
Use brand defaults restores logo, business identity, Google program name, artwork and colour settings. Undo restores the prior brand-control snapshot. It never resets the reward or optional terms.
Preview state changes only the isolated specimen. Updated offer opens Details automatically so the actual location of the offer is visible; it does not replace Reward ready with an advertisement.
Details opens a plain wrapper drawer with Reward, Requirement, Terms and Member ID. Offer appears only in the selected offer example. Phone and email are never printed there.

Preview signup opens the draft customer inspection on phone. Desktop presents the same content beside the acquisition QR. Selecting Creator link changes the acknowledgement to From Jasmine’s Story.; it does not record a campaign click or grant working attribution.
Preview Wallet choices is a wrapper-only inspection entrance. It bypasses neither the disabled signup commit nor the one-live-program rule.
After launch, Live · simulated opens its explanation. Link details explains the cross-browser fixture boundary. Neither note is buried in a global footer.
Preview printout opens a labelled A5 composition. Print demo alone invokes browser printing. Download demo QR produces a labelled local SVG; no pass package or save JWT is generated.

Design Lab opens the shared scenario list, Reset demo and the two explicit creation-failure toggles. Scenario replacement requires Change demo state? and This resets local changes. It is never an ordinary owner setting.
No hover-only explanation is required. Hover can underline an existing action; all information is available by tap and keyboard.
fixture_data: Business is Loopday Coffee, fictional Austin coffee shop. Program name defaults to Loopday Rewards. Timezone is America/Chicago. Lab clock remains September 17, 2026, 10:00 AM CDT.

Fresh creation has kind visits, target 5, reward Free coffee, optional terms empty, logo open-loop, background #18231D, Apple value text #F7F4EB, Apple labels #C4CDBF and /design-lab/reference-loopday-01.jpg artwork.
Points is a replacement kind in this draft, not a second program: target 100, fixed one point per qualifying purchase, maximum one counted qualifying purchase per business day.

Reward name and Reward title reference one value. Reward and business names allow 1 to 40 trimmed characters; Google program name allows 1 to 20. Optional terms allow 0 to 280. Do not silently truncate visible requirements, errors or card state.

Designer specimen: Sara, readable ID LD-001, visits example 3 of 5. It corresponds to the historical September 13 representation, not the working September 17 member projection. No contact appears on the card.

For a custom visits target, collecting specimen progress is the smaller of 3 and target minus 1. For points it is the smaller of 82 and target minus 1. Ready reaches the selected target; redeemed has zero next-cycle progress. These are generated examples, not events.

Signup specimen: Tess, tess@example.test; phone-mode fixture +12025550163; readable example ID LD-011. All progress is zero. The form is read-only and cannot enroll. Its specimen QR is different from Sara's and from acquisition QR payloads.

Known source inspection uses Jasmine, Morning loop, STORY and the fixture registry's loopday-jasmine-story entry. Counter inspection uses BUSINESS_QR and loopday-counter. Merely inspecting either creates no first-touch record.
Draft scenario has Program and Reward completed using the defaults; Card is incomplete. No working member or usable enrollment URL exists.
Successful launch produces one simulated live Loopday program, one reward definition, zero members and zero rewards. All member counts, source results and saved-Wallet counts start at zero.

Local launch activates /design-lab-v3/join/loopday-counter in the same in-memory scenario. Copy builds an absolute URL from the current origin. Another browser has its own fixture state; cross-device persistence is not simulated.
Changing a completed requirement or kind invalidates downstream review completion while retaining compatible branding. It never mutates the seeded working cohort or migrates points into visits.

All app-authored visible wording is closed by visible_copy. Numeric values, selected names and dates may follow data. User-entered field contents are rendered verbatim as input, not supplemented with engineer-invented helper sentences.
